usage_note: Research simulation only; not suitable for operational navigation.

routes.name: Coastal baseline candidate
routes.purpose: Manual baseline candidate following the Vietnamese coast at an offshore distance.
routes.assumption: Waypoints are modelling assumptions and are not official shipping-lane coordinates.

routes.name: Deliberate land-crossing test
routes.purpose: Negative-control route intentionally crossing mainland Vietnam to test the land constraint.
routes.assumption: This route is deliberately invalid and must be rejected by the evaluator.

routes.name: Offshore alternative candidate
routes.purpose: Alternative manual candidate located farther offshore for later weather comparison.
routes.assumption: Waypoints are modelling assumptions and are not official shipping-lane coordinates.
